reason: Goods 5100 is goodsType 7 max 98 getGrowthType 3 and 5200-5213 plus 5220-5222 are the boss Memories (max 99), FMG names match; no EMEVD, HKS or param link from the counter to SpEffect 160000+N exists, so that step stays an exe-side inference from the sekiro-rs doc.

SpEffects 160000+N have identical rates in all eight fields (stateInfo 204) and the steps are +0.25 (2-14), +0.10 (15-27), +0.05 (28-51), but 52 is 6.775 and 53 is 6.77 (lower), so the rule for 53-99 is 6.75 + 0.01*(N-51), not 'add 0.01 to 52'.

fix.summary: Level N picks SpEffect 160000 + N (Player Growth_Core Level N). Its physical, elemental and posture attack rates all carry the same number. Levels 0 and 1 are 1.0, levels 2 to 14 add 0.25 each, 15 to 27 add 0.10, 28 to 51 add 0.05. Level 52 is 6.775 (the only row off the line), and levels 53 to 99 follow 6.75 + 0.01 * (N - 51), so 53 is 6.77 and 99 is 7.23.
